reason: The liners need support to become growing beds, and the salvaged metal looks useful for building it.
expectation: I expect to make supported bed frames or a similar construction, though I don't know whether they will be ready for planting.

Mixing nutrients into water seems useful for crops, but the beds are not ready yet.

effect: The liners now have supported shells and separate lower reservoirs, so the troughs still need a growing medium and nutrients.
reaction: The separate reservoirs make me curious about how the beds will supply air and water to the roots.
reason: Breaking the porous fired bricks into smaller pieces seems like a plausible way to prepare a growing medium for the troughs.
expectation: I expect the hammer to break the bricks into smaller pieces, though I don't yet know whether they will need further preparation.

alternatives.reason: Nutrient solution will likely be useful for the crops, but I want to prepare the bed material first.

effect: The crushed bricks provide a potential growing medium, but the granules need washing and a leach check before they can go near roots.
reaction: The leach check is an interesting reminder that a material needs testing before use in a growing bed.
reason: The wash and test bench appears to be the next place to prepare the granules for the troughs.
expectation: I expect the granules to be washed and checked for substances that might leach out, though I don't know the result.

alternatives.reason: The nutrient solution will likely be needed, but the granules have a clear preparation step first.

effect: The granules passed the leach check and can support roots, but they will not supply nutrients.
reaction: Removing sharp fines as well as dust makes the preparation feel purposeful.
reason: Putting the clean granules in the lined troughs seems like the next step toward making usable root beds.
expectation: I expect to fill the troughs with the granules, though I don't yet know how water and air will reach the roots.

alternatives.reason: The roots will need nutrients, but I want to assemble the beds first.

reaction: The assembly was straightforward; I’m curious how the beds will keep the roots supplied with air.
reason: Mixing the nutrient concentrate with drinking water seems useful because the granules support roots but do not feed them.
expectation: I expect to make a nutrient solution for the troughs, though I don’t know how it will be delivered.

alternatives.reason: The bricks and metal could make another useful construction, but its purpose is less clear.

effect: The nutrient solution is ready to supply food to the roots in the mineral troughs.
reaction: The mixture was straightforward, and I’m still curious how the roots will get air.
reason: Adding the solution to the troughs seems like the next step toward giving the roots water and nutrients.
expectation: I expect the troughs to receive the nutrient solution, though I’m unsure how the arrangement will preserve air around the roots.

alternatives.reason: The bricks and metal may make something useful, but their purpose is less clear.

effect: The solution drains into lower reservoirs and circulates back, explaining how the beds supply water while leaving air around the roots. The chapter is complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to learn how drainage and circulation work together; the separate movable beds were a small surprise.

mostWorthwhile.text: Irrigating the troughs was most worthwhile because it explained how roots can receive both nutrient solution and air.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the clean granules into the troughs was straightforward but offered little new information on its own.

surprise.text: The granules needed a leach check and removal of sharp fines before use; passing the check did not mean they would feed the roots.

arbitrary.text: No action I chose felt arbitrary. The option to combine fired bricks and metal stock had an unclear purpose, but I did not select it.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the practical explanations of water treatment and growing beds made me curious about how the expedition develops.
